rule: A Post Office catalogue logo is research/assets/img/{setId}/logo.png. The file is an official pokemon.com set logo, trimmed to the artwork. The same trim on the Mega Evolution logo matches the catalogue logo pixel for pixel. A set with no allowed logo file is listed under missing and is left on the tile.
